author: Good Enough
description:
Doctors infected patients with malaria... on purpose.

In early insane asylums, “fever therapy” was used to induce high fevers, with patients repeatedly injected and kept in a prolonged state of illness for weeks or even months. It was believed these fevers could treat mental disorders, despite the severe risks and suffering involved.

This video explores one of the most disturbing practices in medical history and what patients were forced to endure.

#medicalhistory
title: Doctors Infected Patients With Malaria 💉😨 #didyouknow #history #darkhistory #disturbing #facts

author: Good Enough
description:
Bloodletting was once considered one of the most effective medical treatments, and it was used for centuries.

Doctors believed removing blood could cure illness, restore balance in the body, and treat everything from fevers to serious diseases, often leaving patients weaker or even worse than before.

This video explores one of the most disturbing practices in medical history and why it was used for so long.
title: The Sicker They Got... More Blood 🩸😨 #history #disturbing #facts #darkhistory
